concepts.title: V3 · Björnen
concepts.brief:
Character: an original mature brown bear colleague, broad grounded shoulders, strong long forearms and carefully articulated short-furred FIVE-DIGIT paws with opposable thumbs. Gently squared broad muzzle, warm umber and dark walnut fur, small kind amber eyes, slightly lighter muzzle and subtle silver flecks near temples. Natural ursine ears, no human hair. Mouth and face expressive but composed, never angry. Plain deep moss overshirt with rolled sleeves over oatmeal crewneck, no decorations. Bear feels sturdy and reassuring with normal-sized head, sophisticated matte soft 3D editorial sculpture, NOT plush baby teddy or photoreal wildlife. Both hands anatomically clean, palm-forward explanation. 
Screen: deep forest-grey #1C2522 canvas, raised #28332E panels, linen #F2EEE5 text and muted warm brass #CAB28A active accents. Thin sage-grey borders, 6 px corners, Lexend throughout. Generous whitespace, serious teaching workspace. Sheet background matches deep forest-grey. Muted green and cream not children's bright colours.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup and stylized-concept. Create ONE beautiful portrait 1024x1536 concept sheet for an ADULT Swedish live voice tutor. Original fictional nonhuman companion only, no resemblance to any existing franchise or mascot. No humans, photos, personal names, trademarks or logos. Audience adults learning university subjects or a trade; companion feels like a patient competent colleague.

IMPORTANT OWNER FEEDBACK: HANDS ARE ESSENTIAL FOR TEACHING GESTURES. Design an upright companion with TWO REAL ARMS AND TWO EXPRESSIVE HANDS, with believable distinct digits and opposable thumbs. Hands visible at a generous size in all four lower portraits, not cropped or concealed in sleeves, feathers or folds. Speaking shows a natural OPEN PALM explanation and another hand gently indicating toward viewer LEFT where the board is. Other states have visibly different arm and hand positions. No wing-hands, fins, mittens, gloves, floating hands or rigid appendages. Normal adult-like body proportions, modest eyes, no enormous baby eyes or head.

Composition: top 7% clear direction title and URL "tutor3.labtopia.dev". Next 42% a complete FRONT-ON flat desktop IN-CALL UI mock: board LEFT 74%, compact companion on RIGHT 26%, full fixed bottom chat input bar. No perspective, device frame, room, scenery, desk, shadows behind panels, dashboard metrics or invented navigation. Header ONLY "Open Tutor" at left and a small menu icon at right. Board shows a calm example headed "Enheter och samband", a clear dimensional relationship "sträcka = hastighet × tid" and a simple line diagram distance over time, no numerical answers or small unreadable labels. Large readable typography. Below companion put pill "Pratar" with small three speech bars and caption "Vi börjar med vad vi vet." Fixed bottom bar: attachment, "Skriv här om du vill…", mic button, muted red "Avsluta". No full transcript, accounts, profile cards or marketing content. Companion unobscured, full elbows and hands visible; gesture goes toward viewer-left and does not cover board text.

Bottom 47% a LARGE 2x2 sheet showing EXACT SAME CHARACTER IDENTITY AND MATERIALS at consistent waist-up scale, full head and TWO hands and elbows within every panel. Top left "Lyssnar": engaged gaze toward viewer, mouth closed, subtle head tilt, both hands loosely open in relaxed attentive posture, ear icon. Top right "Pratar": mouth visibly open mid-explanation, both hands making measured teaching gesture, small speech bars. Bottom left "Förbereder tavlan": eyes look down toward viewer-left, one hand holds a small plain cream notepad and the other uses a pencil, closed mouth, small pencil icon, no speech waves. Bottom right "Väntar": open eyes and relaxed gentle gaze toward viewer-left, closed mouth, both hands loosely folded at waist, hollow circle icon. No waves in any silent state, no sleeping eyes, no busy indicator while waiting. States must be distinguishable by pose and icon in grayscale, not color alone. All faces look at learner or inward toward viewer LEFT, never outside right frame.
Final 4% four labelled palette swatches and "Lexend · 6 px hörn". Subtle premium sculptural illustration with tasteful materials, readable contrast, no glow, no confetti, no graduation cap or glasses, no suit tie, no hoodie, no scarf, no tech HUD, no toy robot. Swedish å ä ö rendered correctly. Sharp flat UI, distinctive warm companion.

concepts.title: V4 · Uttern
concepts.brief:
Character: an original slender mature anthro river otter, smooth grey-brown short fur, long otter muzzle and small black nose, subtle whiskers, small adult hazel eyes, pale stone muzzle and throat, small rounded otter ears. Long flexible forearms with TWO expressive FIVE-DIGIT hands, short fur and separate fingers, thumb opposable. Normal adult-like head-to-torso ratio, not baby/cute round-headed animal. Wearing a simple ink teal collarless work shirt with sleeves rolled to forearms. Calm wry kindness and intelligence, relaxed peer, no exaggerated toothy grin. Render refined tactile 3D illustration, restrained fur detail, beautiful silhouette. No giant tail in frame. Both hands highly legible.

concepts.title: V5 · Form
concepts.brief:
Character: a completely ORIGINAL abstract person-like sculptural companion with TWO ELBOWED ARMS AND TWO VERY EXPRESSIVE HUMANLIKE FIVE-FINGER HANDS WITH THUMBS, made from warm matte limestone ceramic with restrained joint seams. Neither animal nor robot: a fictional living sculptural figure. Mature slender proportions with broad enough shoulders for gestures. Head is an elegant asymmetrical softly faceted pebble-like humanoid form, slight brow ledge, TWO small dark almond eyes with small warm grey irises, short shallow sculptural nose and a subtle movable mouth, no ears, no human hair, no featureless mask, no LED face, no visor. A tiny restrained smile, warm and attentive. Face has enough definition and softness to feel addressable rather than eerie or emotionless. Torso has a deep aubergine felt waistcoat-like integrated fabric panel, bare ceramic forearms and fully articulated hands, no buttons or logos, no suit, no tech machinery, no visible metal. Handmade material texture, premium contemporary editorial sculpture, NOT toy doll, space robot, superhero, ghost, teardrop or existing animated character. Fingers gracefully curled and readable in all gestures; distinct hands at normal adult size.
Screen: dark warm graphite #252326 canvas, raised #322F34 surface, warm cream #F0EAE0 text and muted dusty terracotta #CB9D83 accent. Flat thin bordered 6 px corner cards. Lexend throughout. No glow or grid. Sheet background graphite. Copper colour is a UI accent only, ceramic stays pale limestone.
